_note: Closed source lists per lane. Agents may only search and fetch these domains. Candidates until scripts/check_setup.py confirms each one (searchable and extractable through Tavily). Subdomains of a listed domain are allowed.

news.description: Adverse media and industry news. Open-access outlets only, because paywalled pages cannot be stored for quote verification.

company.description: What the company says about itself, plus registers that identify it. The company's own website is added at run time after entity resolution (one domain per run).

legal.description: Sanctions lists, enforcement and competition cases, courts and insolvency notices. Primary sources only.

science.description: Safety, quality and technical evidence: rail accident and safety authorities, patents and papers.
